name: Recall v1.2.0
body:
## What's new

### Bug fix — terminal right-edge dead space
The terminal was reserving 14 px on the right for a scrollbar that is hidden via CSS, causing text on long lines to appear cut off or wrap one character early. Fixed by computing terminal dimensions from the full container size with no scrollbar deduction.

### Rotating tips toaster
A small tip card in the top-right corner cycles through 47 practical tips every 25 seconds. Shortcuts are OS-aware — Mac users see `⌘T`, Windows/Linux users see `Ctrl+T`. Each tip can be dismissed individually and reappears on the next rotation. Toggle it off anytime in **Settings → General → Show tips**.
